## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or upstream change.

## Validation

Record tests and observed results. Identify missing inputs and remaining device,
audio, or multiplayer checks. For performance changes, include comparable builds,
devices, settings, and scenes.

## Provenance

Identify dependency changes and their upstream/fork commits or patches. Preserve
licenses and attribution. Do not include game data, generated modules, saves,
credentials, signing material, or private diagnostic exports.
